name: evidence-review
title: Insurance evidence review
for_each: select id,code from certificates.vendors where active order by code

sections.title: Supplier and responsibility
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,region,retention_review from certificates.vendors where id=$1

sections.title: Recorded contractual requirements
sections.sql: select pr.name as profile,pr.contract_ref,r.coverage,r.currency,r.minimum_amount,r.additional_insured,r.waiver from certificates.vendors v join certificates.profiles pr on pr.id=v.profile_id join certificates.rules r on r.profile_id=pr.id where v.id=$1 order by r.coverage
sections.note: Limits are recorded contract requirements, not statutory thresholds.

sections.title: Policy evidence
sections.sql: select code,coverage,policy_number,insurer,currency,limit_amount,effective_on,expires_on,evidence_ref,verdict,reviewer,review_evidence from certificates.policy_evidence where vendor_id=$1 order by code
sections.note: Recorded evidence only. A certificate does not amend policy terms or guarantee that a claim is covered.

sections.title: Review and follow-up history
sections.sql: select created_at,action,actor,note from certificates.activity where vendor_id=$1 order by created_at,id

name: renewal-brief
title: Certificate renewal brief
for_each: select distinct v.id,v.code from certificates.vendors v join certificates.policies p on p.vendor_id=v.id where v.active and p.expires_on<=current_date+60 order by v.code

sections.title: Upcoming or expired certificates
sections.sql: select p.code,p.coverage,p.expires_on,p.expires_on-current_date as days_left,p.evidence_ref from certificates.policies p where p.vendor_id=$1 and p.expires_on<=current_date+60 order by p.expires_on

sections.title: Contact owner
sections.sql: select name,owner,region from certificates.vendors where id=$1
sections.note: Internal draft. The responsible owner reviews and sends any request.
